title: Getting Started with Content Blocks
description: How every Randomism block type composes an article body, including Markdown prose.

blocks.content:
Each block declares a `componentType` and a content payload. The registry maps that type to a single React renderer.

Prose fields accept **Markdown** — for example a [link](https://example.com) and `inline code`.

content.alt: Diagram-like illustration of stacked content blocks

sections.title: Why **JSON** blocks?
sections.body: Content stays in versioned files under `data/articles/`. Edit JSON, rebuild, and the page updates — no CMS required.

sections.title: Markdown in titles and bodies
sections.body: Accordion titles and bodies support full CommonMark. Prefer Heading blocks for the primary outline.

blocks.text: Prefer a *small* set of blocks over a page builder.

items: Rebuild — the home list updates automatically

blocks.body: Callout variants are `info`, `tip`, and `warning`. Body text supports **Markdown**.

blocks.content: After a divider, continue with more Heading, Paragraph, or Image blocks as needed.
